question_ko: 같은 AI가 앞서 수행한 연구에서 재사용 가능한 실험 절차를 배웠을 때, 처음 보는 ML 과제를 잘 푸는 데 필요한 총비용이 줄어드는가?
question_en: Does an AI researcher solve previously unseen ML research tasks better or more cheaply after learning executable experimental procedures from earlier tasks, including the full cost of acquiring and maintaining that experience?
learning_location: Harness-level executable procedures, external memory and research workflow; base LLM weights remain fixed.
run_count_note: Lane feasibility example only; root will choose a smaller pilot rather than treat this count as mandatory.

source.title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
source.coverage_note: A truncated combined output was not counted; the affected source ranges were read again in full.

evidence.claim: SkillZip compresses and retrieves existing procedural skill packages through source-grounded section units and reversible contract-bearing macros.
The MiniMax-M2.7 comparison reports SkillsBench reward 27.3 to 33.3 and ALFWorld episode success 67.1 to 79.3 versus SkillDAG.
The structural lifting guarantee does not establish unrecorded semantic equivalence or verifier correctness.
The evaluation contains 87 SkillsBench artifact tasks and 140 ALFWorld valid_seen episodes.

evidence.premise: Scaling to 100K skills demonstrates learning from 100K new research tasks.
evidence.claim: Evaluation queries and target-source annotations remain fixed; added packages are retrieval distractors.
evidence.locator: Appendix D, Retrieval and library scaling

evidence.premise: The reported 71 percent storage reduction applies to total persistent memory.
evidence.claim: Active storage falls from 18.6 to 5.4 MB but 112.4 MB of original source remains retained.
evidence.derived_total_note: Arithmetic sum of reported active and source sizes, not an additional paper result.

evidence.claim: ReZip streaming uses a fixed initial half library plus ten batches, a frozen query set and controlled verifier drift.
Full acquisition-to-maintenance cost amortization of autonomous cross-task scientific learning is not established by the reported execution token and local latency measurements.
evidence.locator: Appendix B.5 and Appendix D cost accounting

evidence.claim: Per-domain procedural compression performance is not a source-to-held-out-target scientific transfer experiment.

novelty_collision.verified_direct_collision: Contract-preserving executable skill compression and incremental maintenance are SkillZip's direct contributions.

unread_navigation_leads.title: Experience Compression Spectrum
unread_navigation_leads.why: Experience abstraction into memories, skills and rules.

novelty_collision.lead_evidence_level: SkillZip references and related-work discussion only; primary papers not read in this lane

followup_full_read.finding: Scientific skill acquisition and refinement directly collide, but own prior research to unseen datasets with full-cost break-even is not directly tested in this retained v1.

novelty_collision.possible_gap: Unseen-dataset experimental-strategy transfer against strong frozen executable procedures under fully amortized acquisition and maintenance costs.

proposed_experiment.claim_scope: Experimental strategy transfer across previously unseen small public classification datasets; not general autonomous scientific discovery.
proposed_experiment.model_portfolio_note: Bounded design choice, not a claim of optimality or currently installed library support.
proposed_experiment.task: Diagnose data, choose successive modeling or preprocessing comparisons under a compute budget, and submit a reproducible final pipeline with evidence for the selection.

arms.name: strong_frozen_researcher
arms.memory: Curated executable experimental basics created without target exposure; no previous own task records or evolution.

arms.name: A_plus_retrieved_raw_research_notebook
arms.memory: Strong retrieval over identical source trajectories including code, experiments, failures and observed results.

arms.name: A_plus_learned_executable_procedures
arms.memory: Extract and validate reusable experimental procedures from the same source records.

proposed_experiment.optional_followup: Only after C establishes useful primary transfer, compare unmerged procedures with consolidated ones. Compression and graphs are not mandatory primary components.
proposed_experiment.target_memory_policy: Restore the identical source-only memory snapshot before each target; no target-to-target learning in the primary experiment.
proposed_experiment.pretraining_contamination_claim: Not eliminated; unseen means unseen during this experiment's experience acquisition and task prompting.

evaluation.primary_metric: Mean independently rerun final-test balanced accuracy on eight unseen tasks at the same total lifecycle budget, after charging experience acquisition and maintenance.
evaluation.budget_status: To be frozen from development-only measurements, not target results.
evaluation.budget_reallocation: A may spend its saved experience-acquisition budget on additional target reasoning and experiments.
evaluation.secondary_matched_budget_view: Equal per-target execution caps isolate memory representation effects from computation allocation.
evaluation.single_cost_conversion: Use a predeclared common rate card and retain raw counters; do not silently price local compute or labor at zero.
evaluation.curated_baseline_sensitivity: Also price the frozen public procedure library at zero initial cost as a strong conservative baseline.
evaluation.crossover_metric: K*: first unseen task count at which cumulative full cost is lower at matched or better quality than the strongest baseline.
evaluation.crossover_limit: If not observed within eight targets, report greater than eight or not observed; no extrapolation to hundreds of tasks.
evaluation.statistical_limit: Eight target datasets with two nested repeats form a pilot, not a powered demonstration of broad scientific generalization.

falsifier: Reject the own-experience-for-unseen-research hypothesis if C fails to beat B and strong A on full-cost held-out outcomes or only helps near-duplicate tasks that permit answer reuse. Any later consolidation is separately rejected if it adds cost without improving unmerged procedures.
strongest_rejection_reason: The entire effect may reduce to retrieving generic ML templates; if frozen curated executable procedures match or beat it, self-acquired scientific learning is not established.

demo.surface: A real unseen task replay compares next experiment, actual prior evidence used, executed experiment count, cumulative full cost and independently rerun final results.
demo.negative_transfer_case: A second task changes applicability conditions so the researcher must decline an old procedure and select a new comparison.
demo.truthfulness: Show failures and a winning frozen baseline if observed; graph animations or prewritten macros are not efficacy evidence.

research_to_product: Thesis evaluates the transfer-and-cost boundary; only the empirically selected design is later ported into the inherited ARGO runtime after explicit construction restart.
